summary: Malemba-Nkulu territory (Haut-Lomami) saw Mai-Mai violence in 2024 (killings of FARDC/PNC officers, a faction led by Makabe's son), but the territorial administrator reported these groups dismantled and calm restored by May 2025, with residual insecurity in Kayumba/Museka. In September 2026 the government flagged a Mai-Mai (Bakata Katanga) resurgence, citing Kyamona village in Mukanga secteur, in parallel with attacks in Mitwaba and Bukama. No source reports durable armed-group control of any town. Malemba-Nkulu and Mulongo towns and most of the territory are assessed under state (PNC) control; the Kyamona area is FARDC-held but contested by raiding Mai-Mai, and the southern Mukanga secteur toward Upemba is a lower-confidence state area exposed to raids.

zones.evidence: Territory headquarters with administrator, police and army; Mai-Mai killings in late 2024 hit FARDC/PNC officers in surrounding villages but the administrator reported the groups dismantled and calm restored by May 2025. No report of militia control of the town in 2026.

zones.description: Mulongo town (Mulongo secteur seat on the Lualaba)
zones.evidence: Large secteur town with state administration; no 2025-2026 reports of armed-group activity in Mulongo. Default state (PNC) presence.

zones.description: Kyamona health area, Mukanga secteur (Kyamona, Katombe, Kakenza 1 & 2)
zones.evidence: The Council of Ministers of 11 Sept 2026 cited Kyamona village (Malemba-Nkulu) as hit by the Mai-Mai resurgence in Grand Katanga, alongside Kisanji in Mitwaba. No report of durable militia administration; the army is assumed to be responding, so state (FARDC) control contested by raiding Mai-Mai.

zones.description: Southern Mukanga secteur toward Upemba park / Mitwaba (Kataba/Kasenga, Bangwe, Shele, Kimwenze areas)
zones.evidence: Rural south of the territory bordering the Upemba park and Mitwaba, where Bakata Katanga Mai-Mai raids resurged in 2026 (Kyamona nearby). No source reports armed-group control of these villages; state presence assumed with Mai-Mai raiding risk.

zones.description: Rest of the territory: Lwamba, Kinkondja and northern Mukanga secteurs and rural Mulongo secteur
zones.evidence: Mai-Mai exactions in 2024 (incl. a faction led by Makabe's son in Bunda groupement) were reported dismantled by May 2025, with residual insecurity only in Kayumba/Museka areas; Haut-Lomami described as calm in Sept 2026 apart from Kyamona. Default state presence (PNC, customary chiefs).
